name: zsnd_sample_get_play_cursor_bytes
description: zSndSample::GetPlayCursorBytes returns zero for guarded samples, queries DirectSound or A3D backend cursor position on supported backends, masks DirectSound failures to zero, and ignores the A3D call result.
known_limits: Reconstruction remains limited only by Binary Ninja HLIL rendering the result mask as neg/sbb/not instead of the source-level DirectSound success check.

VC5SP3 profiles vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_facs, and vc5_o2_ob0_facs compile the source to the original control-flow shape but retain five unmasked byte mismatches in the A3D epilogue load order: VC loads playCursorBytes before moving result from esi to eax, while the original moves esi to eax first. VC5SP3 vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs is worse at ten mismatches.
tier_s_evidence: Binary Ninja for 0x4a3620 returns zero when createGuard is nonzero, dispatches backend 0 to vtable slot 0x10 with play/write cursor outputs and masks nonzero HRESULT to zero, and dispatches backend 1 to vtable slot 0x4c with play cursor output only. Other backend values fall through to the shared result-mask epilogue and are not a deterministic source contract.
The native smoke covers guarded skip, DirectSound success and failure, and A3D cursor return with ignored error code.
